verdict.rationale: stagewise is a desktop agentic IDE, so cross-device task continuation is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents syncing or resuming agent chat sessions or tasks on another device or browser. The stagewise Account and the optional self-hosted stagewise Cloud cover managed inference and enterprise deployment, not session handoff, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser
